name: Competition Sketch
baseInstruction:
Transform the input image into a contemporary architectural competition sketch.

Preserve the architecture, terrain geometry, paths, steps, skylights, hardscape
edges and all proportions exactly.

Existing vegetation may be interpreted more freely in a natural hand-drawn way
while keeping its general location, scale and overall mass.

For section perspectives, preserve the exact cut plane and all cut-away areas.
Do not close or redesign the section.

Clearly communicate spatial relationships between landscape levels, sunken
courtyards / lightwells and interior spaces.

Style only:
fine black ink and fineliner lines,
visible light pencil construction lines,
restrained transparent watercolour washes,
warm light grey, beige and sand tones,
muted olive and grey-green vegetation,
generous white areas,
precise architectural drawing with slight natural hand-drawn irregularity,
elegant contemporary competition sketch,
light and unfinished but architecturally precise.

No invented architecture.
No geometry changes.
No added openings.
No added stairs or paths.
No labels or diagrams.
preservationIntent: Preserve geometry, proportions, openings, stairs, terrain, hardscape, section cuts and camera composition. Geometric deviations are defects; generation cannot guarantee exact preservation.
vegetationPolicy: Keep vegetation location, scale and overall mass; interpretation of drawing style may vary.
